body: Diabolique is a That Boy Hi Hat single released 2026-07-03. It was recorded at Cue Recording Studios in Arlington, Virginia — the official studio position — and produced by Hybrid, co-produced with Black Lansky. Blaine Misner is a recording/mastering engineer at Cue Recording Studios (confirmed via Cue's own history and mastering pages and his SoundBetter profile). The single is distributed across Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, Deezer, Pandora, Amazon Music and Tidal.
